response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM r) SELECT r.arcref, r.fundflux, r.rate, r.rate - b.bench AS gap FROM r CROSS JOIN b WHERE r.rate > b.bench ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A project's rate is total gbsize divided by total spanmin across its scans (ratio of sums), not an average of per-scan ratios.
'Scans that match a project' means an inner join of scans.arcref to projects.arcregistry; scans without a matching project are excluded.
Projects whose total spanmin is zero or NULL have a NULL rate and are left out of the benchmark average and the results.
The benchmark is the plain average of the per-project rates, with each project counted once.

alternatives.interpretation: A project's rate is the average of its individual scans' gbsize/spanmin ratios, rather than total size over total time.
